description: This file defines the LeadsController class, which manages lead-related actions in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for pre-processing lead editing, displaying the edit view, and handling lead conversion logic, integrating with legacy code and the framework.

classes.name: LeadsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling lead-related operations in SuiteCRM, extending the core SugarController class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the controller by calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: pre_editview
methods.description: Preprocesses lead data before rendering the edit view, including conversion from prospect if applicable.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' for the lead editing interface.

methods.name: callLegacyCode
methods.description: Handles lead conversion requests by invoking legacy scripts or default actions.
